name: Delicias de Jany
website_check: Google Maps 'website' field points to their Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/deliciasdejany/), not a real domain. deliciasdejany.com does not resolve (DNS NXDOMAIN, confirmed via getent/python socket.gethostbyname and a direct curl connection attempt that failed at the proxy level with no route to the host). No public street address on the Google Business Profile either (home-based catering, consistent with delivery-only operation).
hours: Mon/Tue/Wed/Thu/Fri 7:00 AM-10:30 PM, Sat/Sun 10:00 AM-11:30 PM

source_of_data.discovery: Business handed off pre-verified (Google Maps rating/reviews/phone/IG already confirmed before this task).
source_of_data.detail: node scripts/gmaps_detail.js <mapsUrl> -> rating 5.0, reviews 25, phone +1 786-320-3881, address: null, website field: instagram.com/deliciasdejany, hours for all 7 days, category 'Caterer'.
source_of_data.reviews: node scripts/gmaps_reviews.js <mapsUrl> 10 -> 4 unique verbatim 5-star reviews in English (Dalal Torras, Maria josefa Pereda, alejandro leal, Grace Escalona); used 3 best for testimonios.
source_of_data.photos: node scripts/gmaps_photocycle.js <mapsUrl> 20 -> 11 unique Google Maps photos, visually curated one by one with Read tool.
source_of_data.instagram: Attempted instagram.com/api/v1/users/web_profile_info/?username=deliciasdejany with Chrome and iPhone UAs plus x-ig-app-id header (2 attempts) and a direct profile page fetch (1 attempt): all 3 returned Instagram's 404/login-wall block page, no usable JSON or HTML. Per pipeline rule (max 2 IG attempts before falling back), fell back to Google Maps photos only. IG handle/URL itself is still verified real via the Google Business Profile 'website' field and via the handle '@deliciasdejany' printed directly on several of the business's own menu/flyer photos pulled from Google Maps.
source_of_data.domain_check: curl -I https://deliciasdejany.com and https://www.deliciasdejany.com both failed to establish a connection (proxy CONNECT tunnel failed / 502), and getent hosts / python socket.gethostbyname both returned 'not known' (NXDOMAIN). Domain does not exist / is not registered to a live site.

reviews_verbatim.author: Dalal Torras
reviews_verbatim.text: The quality and attention to detail are outstanding. The food is delicious, the presentation is gorgeous, and it's clear that everything is made with love. Highly recommend!

reviews_verbatim.author: Maria josefa Pereda
reviews_verbatim.text: Super tasty home made cuban food, love when they make beautiful Charcuteríe boards for my events. Def recommend

reviews_verbatim.author: alejandro leal
reviews_verbatim.text: Excellent food and outstanding delivery service. The meal arrived hot, fresh, and full of flavor, tasting as if it had just been prepared. Every dish was well-seasoned and made with quality ingredients, making each bite enjoyable.

reviews_verbatim.author: Grace Escalona
reviews_verbatim.text: She has been catering our events for a few years. Everything we have ordered is delicious. She takes pride in her business and makes sure all her clients are satisfied. The arroz imperial is my favorite!!!!

menu_source_note: Three of the 11 Google Maps photos are the business's own catering menu/flyer images (in Spanish) with exact published prices: Desayuno Buffet $25/persona; Aperitivos por bandeja (Charcutería $130, Charcutería de Cookies $80, Bandeja de Frutas $90, Albondigas $40, Salchichas ahumadas $45, Camarones envueltos en bacon $55, Camarones al Ajillo $50, Empellas $60, Tostones Rellenos $4 c/u, Trozitos de Pollo $45, Huevos Rellenos $40, Queso para picar $30, Ensalada Fria $65, Dip de Pollo $50, Ensalada de Tuna $40, Higos envueltos en Proscuitto $45, Queso Brie $30, Papitas Asadas $35, Surtido de Croquetas $40, Frituras de Malanga/Maiz/Bacalao $30-40, Bocaditos $40); Sopas $5-10; Pastas $13-15; Mariscos $18-25 (Enchilado de Camarones $20, Enchilado de Langosta $23, Arroz con Camarones $20, Arroz con Langosta y Camarones $23, Paella de Mariscos $25, Arroz con Pescado $18, Salmon en Crema de Champiñones $18); Postres Caseros $20-35 (Flan $25, Pudding de Pan $20, Arroz con Leche $35, Natillas $30, Dulce de Fruta Bomba $35). Note on flyer: 'Los precios pueden variar depende de la cantidad y acompañante que escoja.' Min. 10 personas. These exact prices were used in servicios.cards instead of invented 'se cotiza' copy, since real pricing was verifiably published.
service_area_note: A 'Lo que ofrecemos' flyer photo states (verbatim, Spanish): 'Estamos en Miami y también servimos a Ft.Lauderdale, Ft.Myers y Lehigh Acres' and 'Escríbenos por Instagram DM o llámanos para hacer tu pedido'.
gallery_curation_notes: 11 Google Maps photos reviewed individually. 2 were duplicate near-identical shots of a promotional charcuterie flyer WITH text/price overlay and a Cuban flag watermark (excluded from gallery per no-text-overlay rule, kept only as pricing reference). 3 were pure menu/flyer graphics with no food photography (excluded, used only as data source for real prices and bio copy). 2 clean full-resolution food photos with zero text had no promotional overlay at all (flan dessert, charcuterie board) and were used directly as hero.jpg and galeria/nosotros images. The remaining 3 Google Maps photos were promotional collages (multiple real sub-photos arranged on a flyer background with captions/arrows/headline text around them, e.g. 'ORGANIZANDO UNA FIESTA?', 'Cajitas individuales...', 'PAELLA DE MARISCOS'); the individual food sub-photos inside those collages (congri with roast chicken and peppers, prosciutto/burrata salad, fried sweet plantains, boxed charcuterie cajitas, individual pasta-salad cups, a box of cupcakes and pastelitos) were cropped out with PIL to remove all surrounding text/graphic-design elements, each crop reviewed visually afterward and re-tightened until clean of any stray text or neighboring-photo slivers, then used as genuine (uncropped-content, only framed) food photography. One jagged die-cut paella photo was tried but discarded because its torn-paper edge design could not be cropped clean without losing most of the food. A small square business logo crop (with white padding) was taken from a clean header area of one menu flyer for brand.logo. All final assets verified with `file` (JPEG) and resized to max 1000px wide where the source exceeded that.
notes: No email found anywhere (no IG bio accessible due to block, no linktree, no domain, no mailto on any Maps-sourced material). Contact channels are phone and Instagram DM only, both confirmed via the business's own flyer copy ('Escríbenos por Instagram DM o llámanos'). No evidence of WhatsApp (no WhatsApp icon/link anywhere in the sourced material), so cta is Instagram DM (ig_url) rather than a wa.me link, with tel: offered as a secondary contact card. status: staging, not deployed by this routine (no wrangler deploy run, per task instructions).
